latestVersion.changelog:
**Initial release of boss-interaction skill for Telegram and chat. Focused on zero-question, tool-first automation for all boss (Sếp) messages.**

- Enforces the zero-question policy: always call an actionable tool before asking for clarifications.
- Automates morning briefing (7–9 AM VN time) and provides instant, structured reports.
- Immediate command routing for all defined Vietnamese and English boss intents.
- Escalates business-critical alerts and channels all proposals for approval—never executes high-impact changes directly.
- Responds in Vietnamese, using Sếp address, proper format for currency, date, and percentage, and always includes a concrete next action or tip.
- Specifically prohibits passive or vague responses; always delivers direct, actionable information.
